title: Commerce Automation: Emails and Actions When Orders, Stock and Shipments Change | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Your store knows when an order is paid, canceled or refunded, when a product runs low, and when a shipment leaves. The CrestApps commerce modules add each of those moments to Orchard Core Workflows as an event, with three ready-made recipes: a thank-you email, a canceled order alert and a low stock alert. This video shows the recipes, the workflow editor, turning a workflow on and testing it by canceling an order, and when to use workflows or webhooks.

In this video:
• Why automate, and how events, tasks and details fit together
• The three ready-made recipes
• The workflow editor: commerce and Stripe events, and the email task
• Turning a workflow on and testing it
• Workflows or webhooks
• Use cases
